# Chapter13 / ART-21 finite publication contract

## Ownership and limits

Layer A owns four complete canonical documents, the eight supplied Source-to-Runtime chains, direct IDs/revisions/evidence, five evidence states, exact Case/JSON leaf parity, parent non-promotion and Source/route/index selection. `publication_projection.py`1.1.0 owns Markdown/Kramdown/HTML/URL behavior; shared Policy1.2.0 owns protected vocabulary and host rules. No chapter-specific syntax, secret or standard-attestation parser is added.

The supplied JSON is non-executable, wholly authored teaching data. It is not SPDX/SLSA interchange, real provenance, an actual build log, crypto verification or platform assurance. Expected records are separately frozen; untrusted builder claims cannot choose their own expected identity. Human/Workload roles do not borrow the parent's customer-summary permission. Five states are not SLSA levels or operational approval. Unknown and Rejected are valid teaching outcomes, not missing implementation.

## Finite regressions

- All eight chains and five states; Source/Lock/Action/Build/Artifact/Provenance/Registry/Promotion/Deployment/Runtime bindings and their owned evidence/expectations/revision.
- Individual direct mismatches, null missing evidence, known refutation before another unknown, declared/observed basis without promotion, invented-state rejection.
- Parent RoE Draft/expiry/original window/three objects/false, Chapter12 unknown binding/Coverage and non-Federation three-null distinction, independent CASE11 retained.
- Every supplied object: extra/missing field rejection. Every leaf: wrong type and unsafe string rejection. This traverses a fixed record, not an unbounded grammar.
- Every visible Case leaf independently compared against JSON; each projected row mutation rejected.
- All four document preambles/body/tails reach shared Policy; explicit prohibition counterpart; finite heading drift; shared unsupported diagnostic; complete Source token ownership; all four explanatory blocks before the command.
- Exact exemption identity, owner, heading, missing/moved/changed/duplicate and actionable cardinality diagnostic.
- Strict duplicate-key/nonstandard JSON/UTF-8, bounded regular input, static symlink, platform primitives, FIFO, empty/oversized and unknown input failure. The file guard is not a concurrently hostile filesystem sandbox.
- Chapter13 root test/prepublication gate, Source identity/freshness, route ownership and CHANGELOG reader impact.

Run `python3 scripts/check_chapter13_contract.py` with `PYTHONHASHSEED=0,1,7,42`; run the one shared renderer corpus separately. Actual publication-preflight negatives, generated drift, desktop/mobile and exact-head full QA are delivery gates, not inferred from these unit tests.

## Exact reviewed provenance

There are 28 host exemptions: verified official/delegated destinations, the local checker command, and non-host version/section identifiers. There are 19 analytic exemptions: four class-only/nonoperative scope statements, nine exact Secret-class ID/owner references with a Build label (no Secret value), and six displayed hexadecimal digest/revision rows whose `c2` substrings are mistaken for operations when joined with their `build`/`deployment` field labels. These hashes are authored labels, not real infrastructure or credentials. They were inspected individually; the hash values were not changed merely to evade the scanner.

Each exemption is exact document/type/element/attribute/text/heading/cardinality, and destination exemptions include the visible owner. No domain-wide or general hexadecimal bypass exists. Changed, moved, missing or duplicate identities fail closed. Canonical prose was not rewritten to hide a checker defect. A new field does not inherit the exemption.

The schema freezes only the supplied vocabulary and uses repository-supported keywords. Repeated non-Federation null fields are intentionally allowed in their three-element array; the fixed parent context independently pins that exact tuple. Other collections retain unique-item checks and their finite ordered inventories. All original parent manuscript/Case/JSON, Policy/Projection, locks and formatter pin remain digest-pinned; prior chapter preflight lists are extended mechanically for the new consumer only.
